Section 6: Time Off and Leave Policy

6.1 Annual (Vacation) Leave
Full-time employees accrue annual leave based on tenure. Employees with less than 2 years of service accrue 15 days per year. Employees with 2 to 5 years of service accrue 20 days per year. Employees with more than 5 years of service accrue 25 days per year. Part-time employees accrue a prorated amount based on scheduled hours.

6.2 Sick Leave
All full-time employees receive 10 sick days per year, credited on January 1. Unused sick leave may be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days into the following year. Sick leave beyond 3 consecutive days requires a doctor's note.

6.3 Parental Leave
Birth parents are eligible for 12 weeks of paid parental leave. Non-birth parents, including adoptive and foster parents, are eligible for 6 weeks of paid parental leave. Parental leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or placement date.

6.4 Notice Periods
Employees must submit annual leave requests at least 10 business days in advance for absences of 3 or more consecutive days. For single-day absences, 2 business days of notice is required. Sick leave has no advance notice requirement, but the absence must be reported to a manager by 9:00 AM on the day of absence.

6.5 Carry-Over
Employees may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Any annual leave balance beyond 5 days as of December 31 is forfeited, except where local law requires otherwise.

6.6 Payout on Exit
Upon separation from the company, employees are paid out for unused annual leave at their final base rate of pay, up to a maximum of 10 days. Sick leave is not paid out upon exit under any circumstance.
